support_claim: The packet shows CRM record OAK-77 labeled "Oakfield Logistics", billing under "Oakfield Logistik GmbH", and a note that Oakfield Logistics GmbH rebranded to Oakfield Logistik GmbH with unchanged HRB 88421 while CRM retains an old English-facing name, but no observation explicitly links OAK-77 to that legal entity or to the billed name.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing evidence of identity between crm:OAK-77 and billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH; the CRM row, rebranding note, and billing name are compatible but do not cite a shared registration identifier or an explicit statement that OAK-77 denotes the same counterparty as Oakfield Logistik GmbH, and name overlap without such linkage is insufficient to close identity or distinctness.
